title: NFT Junior
tagline: NFT Junior is an NFT marketplace for families and kids
description: NFT Junior is a Zora-compatible NFT marketplace allows kids and family members to upload their art and share it within their family. Art is minted into NFTs and can be traded amongst family members. Kids can mint and share their art within their family, trading it for fun tokens. Older family members have access to the  full Zora marketplace protocol for their art, should they choose.
how_its_made: We created a Families smart contract to manage arbitrary family units. We customized the Zora protocol to add a layer that understands families with added controls for privacy and sharing for kids artwork. Art is uploaded to IPFS. We plan to eventually add a separate, durable, private file store for art that isn't intended for the broader public.
